entries.answer_en: The Sports Facilities page lists Sports Activities Building G1 for male users and Building B1 for female users. Its listed facilities include an Olympic Swimming Pool, Fitness Hall and CrossFit Hall, outdoor courts, and indoor courts. This published list does not verify a live booking, current seat or facility opening.

entries.answer_en: UAEU Library Research Data Services explicitly offers Data Visualization and Data Cleaning assistance. The same page lists data-management planning and open-science guidance, data coaching and statistical consultations, digital publishing, and data-hosting/repository guidance. The published contact is rds@uaeu.ac.ae; the inquiry form requests details of the research/data assistance needed. It does not establish that an inquiry has been submitted through this chat.
entries.answer_ar: تقدم خدمات البيانات البحثية بالمكتبة مساعدة في تنظيف البيانات وتمثيلها بصريًا وتصويرها بيانيًا، إلى جانب تخطيط إدارة البيانات والعلم المفتوح والاستشارات الإحصائية والتدريب على البيانات والنشر الرقمي وإرشادات المستودعات. وتذكر الصفحة البريد rds@uaeu.ac.ae ونموذج الاستفسار؛ ولا يعني ذلك إرسال الطلب من هذه المحادثة.
